t: An ultra-low-power chip family for smartwatches and always-listening gadgets.
steps: Buy an Apollo4 evaluation board from a distributor such as Future Electronics. The Blue Lite board costs about 150 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the Arm GCC compiler and the SEGGER J-Link software.
Install Zephyr and follow its Apollo4 Plus EVB guide.
Build and flash the Zephyr blinky example.
Try Ambiq's neuralSPOT kit and its heartKIT demo next.
